fact_text: The G99 Developers CEO said vertical development is the real-estate technology shaping Lahore, offering lower-cost, efficient living that keeps privacy and absorbs rural-to-urban migration.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The reporter noted that Lahore faces a space shortage, so the city is growing vertically rather than horizontally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Horizontal expansion makes residents travel long distances to services such as courts and passport offices, which stresses transit corridors and shows up as traffic congestion in Lahore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Young buyers, millennials and freelancers earning dollar income respond positively to apartment living, which offers privacy, freedom from joint-family friction and uninterrupted internet and electricity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Older buyers hold the view that neither land nor a roof is theirs, which slows acceptance of vertical living, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The Punjab Apartment Ownership Act 1995 gives an apartment or shop buyer a share of the underlying land in proportion to the unit, so the owner can sell, mortgage, rent or lease the unit with land-level rights.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said multi-storey buildings use reinforced concrete structures, which are stronger than brick-built houses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said South Lahore's Pine Avenue corridor is developing fast on vertical projects and is expected to become the new Lahore, because the area is densely populated and major brands are setting up along it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest credited the SL-3 ring road interchange for the Pine Avenue corridor's growth; high-income residents move toward Lake City or Bahria Town, while lower-income traffic flows toward Raiwind Road.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Job and business opportunities draw people from cities around Lahore, and population has grown quickly along the Multan Road corridor, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: An amnesty scheme aimed to document the undocumented economy, but black money entered the market and set off speculation in which buyers rushed into real-estate forms and files and many got trapped.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: After the speculative correction, the Competition Commission of Pakistan, NAB, the LDA and the CDA became active, ran temporary crackdowns and raised taxes to build a regulatory framework.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said the market is moving from a speculative, casino-style phase into a mature, steady market that should give future investors more confidence.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The CDA has banned 21 housing societies in Islamabad, the guest said, after they oversold land during the speculative period.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: In an illustrative example the guest gave, a developer with 1,000 kanal of land sold 5,000 kanal, which is the kind of overselling he said happened in Islamabad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest's reasoning was that before investing in a peri-urban society, an investor should ask whether they or someone they know would want to live there; a no suggests the project is speculative.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: In a hype market buyers ignore development, surroundings and logistics, which creates oversupply and later losses for buyers, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Plots in many societies that the LDA has not approved still sell, the reporter said, and such frauds trap buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: About 45% of the FDI that came into Pakistan in 2013 went into real estate, which the guest read as investor confidence in the property market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: As of 25 Jan 2026, around 30% of FDI was flowing back into real estate, which the guest said shows renewed confidence in the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: As of 25 Jan 2026, overseas Pakistani confidence in real estate was returning as government checks on speculation took shape, the guest said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest's view was that overseas investors would be better served by established, approved societies than by newly set-up peri-urban ones.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said filers pay a hefty amount of tax on property, that overseas holders face the same filer rates, and that he did not understand the non-filer category.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The reporter said non-filers find it extremely difficult to buy property, and withholding tax also applies to property transactions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest expected taxes to be raised temporarily to discourage speculation during the transition, then shifted in 2026 to promote transaction volume rather than the amount of each deal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: A tax on the amount of each property transaction reduces transaction volume, the guest said, while development adds to GDP and each sale adds liquidity to the market, as day traders do in stocks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said the Central Business District will take time to develop, and once it does it will become a business hub where people can live, work and run businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest estimated 8 to 10 years before sizeable CBD development becomes visible, and said that as of 25 Jan 2026 only one or two CBD projects were starting.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said Punjab's government supports urban and vertical development because farmland is being lost, but more urban development work is still needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest put the value of Pakistan's real-estate sector at about 2 trillion US dollars, and said building on it adds to that value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The 2025 POIP ordinance was meant to bring checks and balances to the property market, the guest said; it had not yet been approved and the High Court has challenged it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said Pakistan needs a RERA-type regulator like those in India and the UAE, with banks integrated into the property financing process.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: Under the model described, a bank would profile buyers and offer installments over 10 to 25 years, releasing payments against construction milestones such as completing a basement or a floor.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said Pakistan's defence exports have begun, and that the UAE and Saudi Arabia have made investment pledges to Pakistan alongside them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest argued that Pakistan's defence alliances make the country safer, and that a safer Pakistan makes every investment there, in stocks or real estate, safer too.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest cited the rollover of a 4.6 billion US dollar loan involving Saudi Arabia as part of the defence-linked dealings that strengthen Pakistan's position.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest said Turkey is also joining a defence alliance with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, which he likened to an Islamic NATO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)

fact_text: The guest expected Pakistan to record a balance-of-payments surplus for the first time in place of a deficit within a few years, as defence exports and capital inflows rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Real Estate in Lahore: Growth, Fraud & Future | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-25)
